Title: Rules Question: Aching beauty and Tangle

Messages.Author: Sutekh_23
Messages.Body:
Minion A has an aching Beauty on it and declares a bleed.
Meth B declines to block and plays bounce (be it deflection,
redirection, whatever)
Meth C declares a legal block
Minion A plays Tangle Atrophos' Hand.

What is the result of this course of action? I.E., what is tainted by
NRA and who loses pool from the AB?

My logic says Meth C burns a pool for attempting to block, then as a
result of the tangle, minion A is untapped and free to bleed again. Is
this correct?

Cheers
Sutekh_23

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sutekh_23 wrote:
> Minion A has an aching Beauty on it and declares a bleed.
> Meth B declines to block and plays bounce (be it deflection,
> redirection, whatever)
> Meth C declares a legal block
> Minion A plays Tangle Atrophos' Hand.
>
> What is the result of this course of action? I.E., what is tainted by
> NRA and who loses pool from the AB?

Tangle cancels the block attempt before the block is successful.
No taint. No Aching Beauty pool loss.

> My logic says Meth C burns a pool for attempting to block, then as a
> result of the tangle, minion A is untapped and free to bleed again. Is
> this correct?

Aching Beauty: "If this Toreador is blocked, ..."
